subject: Acme - Post-call TCO recap & next steps
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Acme - Post-call TCO recap & next steps

Hi Sarah

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the most relevant cost/TCO takeaways for your team. I focused on the token economics and operational levers we discussed so you can share with procurement and finance.

Key pain points you called out
- High per-month inference volume (~1.2B tokens across chat/assist flows) driving unpredictable spend
- Strict budget cap for Q4 (USD 80k/month) and requirement for 6-month ROI analysis
- Need to keep latency under 250ms p95 for user-facing searches; some internal batch jobs can tolerate higher latency

Goals we agreed
- Reduce per-token unit cost while keeping top-tier models for the user-facing pathways
- Use batching/caching and model routing to meet latency & budget SLOs
- Pilot with production traffic pattern to validate unit economics before Q4 procurement

Preliminary TCO summary (monthly estimates, based on your stated throughput)
- Option A - Hosted API (pay-as-you-go): ~1.2B tokens * $0.025/1k tokens => ~$30,000/month raw token cost. After expected 20% prefix caching + 10% batching reduction in billable tokens, net estimate: ~$21,000/month.
- Option B - Dedicated (reserved capacity) w/ autoscaling: baseline infra + reserved discount => raw estimate ~$22,000/month, after caching/batching and batching-friendly runtime => ~$15,000/month effective (approx 30% lower than hosted at scale).

How we arrived at those numbers
- Token unit used: per-1k-token pricing (see attached pricing sheet).
- Caching: prefix and KV caching savings assume 15-25% reuse for your conversational flows; if you have heavier prompt reuse we can push to 30-40%.
- Batching: request-side batching for high-throughput internal jobs can reduce per-token latency and cost; we assumed conservative 10% token reduction for mixed traffic.
- Model routing: mix critical user-facing calls on a higher-cost model and non-critical flows on a smaller model - we modeled a 60/40 split in the attached workbook.

ROI framing (6 months) - conservative scenario
- Hosted: ~$21k/month => $126k over 6 months.
- Dedicated: ~$15k/month => $90k over 6 months.
- Estimated net savings switching to Dedicated + optimizations: ~$36k over 6 months (40% improvement).

Attachments: redwood_tco_20260907.xlsx (detailed assumptions), redwood_pricing_sheet_v3.pdf

Proposed next steps
1) I can provide a line-item TCO workbook showing per-route breakdown and sensitivity to caching + batching (attached).
2) Pilot: 6-week pilot on Dedicated or Hosted (we can size a small reserved pool) to validate assumptions.
3) Schedule: are you available next Wednesday or Thursday for a 30-min follow-up to walk the workbook with procurement?

If you want, I can also run a third scenario that models a 3-model strategy (high/medium/low) and the expected ROI by traffic split.

Thanks - looking forward to your thoughts.

Best,
Rafael
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_tco_20260907.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)]
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_sheet_v3.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)]

1) Can you produce the 6-month ROI in the workbook with a conservative/high case (i.e., 10% vs 30% caching effectiveness)? Procurement will want a worst-case plan.
2) For the Dedicated estimate, can you break out the one-time provisioning/setup/ingress costs vs monthly run-rate?
3) Our procurement timeline is tight - aiming to finalize vendor selection by end of October.

Also, are there any compliance or SOC2 artifacts you can share ahead of procurement review? If possible, please attach or link.

I'll bring in our procurement lead (procurement@acmecorp.com) once we have the detailed numbers.

Best,
Sarah
Director of Product Ops | Acme Corp

> Key pain points you called out
> - High per-month inference volume (~1.2B tokens across chat/assist flows) driving unpredictable spend
> - Strict budget cap for Q4 (USD 80k/month) and requirement for 6-month ROI analysis
>
1) 6-month ROI conservative/high cases - attached worksheet has three tabs: conservative (10% caching), base (20% caching), aggressive (30% caching). Conservative 6-month numbers: Hosted ~ $140k, Dedicated ~ $102k (after credits/optimizations). Aggressive: Hosted ~ $108k, Dedicated ~ $78k. See tab "6mo_summary".

2) Dedicated breakdown (see tab "infra_breakdown"):
- One-time provisioning & setup: estimated $8k (capacity reservation & onboarding engineering time)
- Monthly reserved infra run-rate: ~$13.5k/month (includes node-hours and reserved GPU amortization)
- Operational (support, monitoring): included in platform fee for first 90 days for pilots

3) Compliance artifacts - attaching SOC2 summary and pointer to shared compliance folder in the related links. Procurement should have everything they need there.

Pilot offer
- We can offer a $15k pilot credit (applied to platform + token usage) tied to a 6-week pilot; we will size a reserved pool to match your traffic profile.

Next steps
- I attached an updated redwood_tco_20260907_v2.xlsx that includes the conservative/high cases and infra breakout.
- Would you be available for a 30-min review on Thu Sep 10 at 10:00 AM PT or Fri Sep 11 at 9:00 AM PT?

If you prefer, I can also provide an anonymized runbook of a similar customer migration that shows realized caching improvements.

Best regards,
Rafael
